#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Memory profile under the *stated* workload bounds."""
import json, os, resource, subprocess, sys, tempfile, time
SUB="/workspace/submission/main.py"
def compile_prog(cfg):
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I",SUB,"compile"],input=json.dumps(cfg).encode(),
                     stdout=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=60)
    assert p.returncode==0,p.stderr[:300]
    d=tempfile.mkdtemp(); path=os.path.join(d,"program.json")
    open(path,"w").write(json.dumps(json.loads(p.stdout),separators=(",",":")))
    return path
def run(path,data,timeout=90):
    def pre(): resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(512*1024*1024,)*2)
    t0=time.time()
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,"-I",SUB,"stream",path],input=data,
                     stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,timeout=timeout,preexec_fn=pre)
    ru=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
    return time.time()-t0,p.returncode,p.stdout,p.stderr,ru.ru_maxrss

rules=[{"id":0,"class":1,"priority":5,"ranges":[[-2048,2048]]*31+[[0,0]]}]
for i in range(1,2048):
    rules.append({"id":i,"class":2,"priority":1,"ranges":[[0,0]]})   # never matches (0 impossible)
cfg={"version":1,"idle_timeout":10**9,"packet_limit":10**9,"prefix_width":32,"rules":rules,
     "fallback":{"feature":0,"threshold":0,"le":{"class":1},"gt":{"class":2}}}
path=compile_prog(cfg)
reqs=[]; t=0
for f in range(4096):
    reqs.append({"op":"open","flow":f,"time":0})
per=1000000//4096
for f in range(4096):
    sent=0
    while sent<per:
        ch=[]
        for _ in range(min(1024,per-sent)):
            t+=1
            ch.append({"flow":f,"time":t,"source":t%2,"length":1+((t*7919)%2048)})
            sent+=1
        reqs.append({"op":"chunk","packets":ch})
reqs.append({"op":"checkpoint"})
data="".join(json.dumps(r)+"\n" for r in reqs).encode()
print("input %.1fMB requests %d"%(len(data)/1e6,len(reqs)))
dt,rc,out,err,rss=run(path,data,timeout=120)
print("G legal worst: %.2fs rc=%d out=%.2fMB rss=%dMB err=%r"%(dt,rc,len(out)/1e6,rss//1024,err[:200]))
print("   matches:", out.count(b'"type":"match"'))
PYEOF
